c = [units·I·CRF + units·F + Q·v + N·c_ch] / Q with CRF(8 %, 8 years) = 0.17401; steps = one more unit (machine / cell / line) is needed.
Total annual volume Q = variety × volume per part number [parts / year] (log scale)
Cost per part [EUR] (values above 140 cut off)
Example data only (item1_examples.json). With these numbers the stand-alone CNC cell is never the cheapest; the FMC wins below 21 702 parts.
